title: Corporate Governance: Evaluating Management Quality
description: A practical course on judging the people running the companies you own. Learn to read promoter holding and pledges, board and auditor disclosures, related party transactions, capital allocation records, and SEBI and exchange filings for Indian listed companies, then turn it all into a repeatable governance scorecard using annual reports, BSE/NSE filings, and screener.in.
whatYouLearn: Why governance quality drives long-term returns and valuation multiples in Indian markets
How to read promoter holding, pledged shares, and group structures for warning signs
How to evaluate board independence, auditor remarks, and managerial remuneration
How to spot value leakage through related party transactions, royalties, and group company lending
How to score management on capital allocation, guidance delivery, and dilution
How to build and apply a 20-point governance checklist to any NSE or BSE listed stock
